description: BitRouter's official plugin marketplace — the agent plugin ships from the same repo as the router itself.

plugins.name: bitrouter
plugins.description: Route model calls through BitRouter and delegate long-running, parallel workflows to BRO Goals over ACP-compatible harnesses. The bro and bro code interfaces show Goals, current-Goal input and a read-only Workflow. Native harness launchers, headless run, native BRO ACP v1/v2 and transparent external acp serve and separately privileged native task APIs remain available. Bundles the BitRouter setup and operations skill. Finished scoped local work has evidence-gated recovery; unresolved effects remain blocked. Tasks can select acknowledged BRO model routes, configured MCP and versioned skill/context material; supplied configuration does not prove actual use. Current-Goal resource edits are versioned and reach replacement execution after old-work reconciliation.
